a: Regular expressions match text patterns; test them before using on user input.
\d matches a digit; \d+ matches one or more digits.
* and + are greedy; *? and +? are lazy.
[abc] matches a, b, or c; [^abc] matches anything else.
Escape special characters with \ when you want the literal.
Unbounded patterns on user input can hang (catastrophic backtracking).
